The extension contains critical security flaws primarily due to its installation mechanism. It downloads and executes remote shell scripts (`curl | bash` / `powershell | iex`) from an unverified domain (`sabre.rroessler.io`). This allows the remote server to execute arbitrary code on the user's machine. Additionally, the extension passes the entire `process.env` to the spawned process, potentially leaking sensitive environment variables. These behaviors constitute a high-risk supply-chain attack vector.
